doc: A tooltip is to provide additional information about a particular element when the user hovers their cursor over it. It typically appears as a small box or pop-up near the element and may contain text, images, or other media to provide context or guidance to the user. Tooltips are commonly used to explain the purpose of buttons, icons, or other interactive elements in an interface, enhancing user understanding and usability.
